entries.source:
Warrior Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The symbol on the chest of the male version is known as the Celtic Wheel of Being.
* The individual armor components are very similar in structure to components from previously released armor sets.
:*Comparison

Helm: Male / Female: Warrior Elite Templar armor
Cuirass: Male / Female: Warrior Elite Sunspear armor
Gauntlets: Male / Female: Warrior Primeval armor
Leggings: Male / Female: Warrior Luxon armor
Boots: Male / Female: Warrior Luxon armor
The inventory icon for the male boots show parts of the bearer's skin.
The inventory icon for the female chest piece show parts of the bearer's skin.
The male armor has clipping issues with the bandana.
entries.text:
戰士紀念碑護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，黑檀（Ebon Vanguard）稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Shadow Agent）。

男性胸甲上的符號稱為 Celtic Wheel of Being。
各部位的結構與先前推出的護甲部位非常相似。外觀比較如下：
頭盔：男女皆為戰士精英騎士護甲。
胸甲：男女皆為戰士精英日戟護甲。
手套：男女皆為戰士太古護甲。
護腿：男女皆為戰士勒克森護甲。
靴子：男女皆為戰士勒克森護甲。
男性靴子的物品欄圖示會露出穿戴者的部分皮膚。
女性胸甲的物品欄圖示會露出穿戴者的部分皮膚。
男性護甲搭配頭巾時會穿模。
entries.reason: 保留第5級製作門檻；逐列核對男女共用外觀、物品欄圖示露膚與頭巾穿模，不再輸出表格樣式。

entries.reason: 逐列核對背心男女外觀差異與共用部位；保留原始表情指令，將clipping與distorted分別譯為穿模與變形。

Mesmer Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The individual armor components are similar to components from previously released armor sets.
Mask: Female: Mesmer Costume Mask; Male: New Model
Attire: Female: Mesmer Elite Rogue armor; Male: Mesmer Canthan armor
Gloves: Female: Mesmer Elite Sunspear armor; Male: Mesmer Elite Canthan armor
Hose: Female: Mesmer Obsidian armor; Male: Mesmer Obsidian armor
Footwear: Female: Mesmer Elite Sunspear armor; Male: Mesmer Ancient armor

This armor is unaffected by outside lighting, it will always seem to "glow" even when in dark light.

entries.source:
Mesmer Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Mesmer Krytan armor art does not have headgear, but the Mesmer Costume Mask are available from the same armorer in Factions. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page. In Prophecies, the Animal, Imposing and Sleek masks are also available, from collectors.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor.

entries.text:
幻術師科瑞塔護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的收藏家兌換護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》取得。

科瑞塔護甲外觀本身沒有頭部裝備，但在《盟與敵》可向同一名護甲製作商製作 Mesmer Costume Mask；圖片與製作資料列於該面具頁面。《阿斯卡隆戰記》的收藏家另有 Animal、Imposing 和 Sleek 面具可供兌換。

科瑞塔護甲沒有高階版本。

收藏家兌換 — 阿斯卡隆戰記
阿斯卡隆（災變前）：防禦等級 7；上衣：5 個古怪的種子；手套：3 個冰磁石；長褲：3 個蜘蛛腿；鞋子：3 個燒焦外殼 / 5 個石像鬼頭顱。
阿斯卡隆（災變後）：防禦等級 21；上衣：4 個強韌的爪；手套：4 個燒焦的石像鬼頭顱；長褲：4 個華麗的穴居人項鍊；鞋子：4 個惡臭的甲殼。
北席娃山脈：防禦等級 27；上衣：5 個彎曲的牛頭怪角；手套：5 個石峰標誌；長褲：5 個霜火尖牙；鞋子：5 個柏木種子。
科瑞塔：防禦等級 39；上衣：5 個森林牛頭怪角 / 5 個陰影殘留物；手套：5 個石像魔頭顱 / 5 個泥麟怪的鰭；長褲：5 個陰影殘留物 / 5 個灼熱的心臟；鞋子：5 個石像魔頭顱 / 5 個灼熱的心臟。
梅古瑪叢林：防禦等級 51；上衣：5 個白斗篷紋章 / 5 個多刺的甲殼；手套：5 個黑檀蜘蛛腿 / 5 個黑檀蜘蛛腿；長褲：5 個叢林鱗怪的鰭 / 5 個叢林巨魔尖牙；鞋子：5 個梅古瑪鬃毛 / 5 個遠古之眼。
